rows.name: I am sorry
rows.descriptionMd: When you are apologising, quiet beats grand and early beats late. Pale roses, white tulips and freesias are the right register, and the card matters more than the flowers — write it yourself and we will print it on our card. Choose where it is going and the day you want, and we take care of the rest. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoDescription: Pale roses, white tulips and freesias with your own words on a printed card. Quiet rather than grand, and it arrives on the date you pick.
